brief:
Israeli airstrikes killed at least nine people in Gaza over the past 48 hours, according to Al Jazeera, citing the Palestinian health ministry. The deaths bring the overall toll since an October 2025 ceasefire began to 1,671.

The continuation of fatalities undermines claims that the ceasefire has halted fighting in the territory. No breakdown of the nine deaths or details of the strikes were provided.
dek: Gaza death toll rises to 1,671 Israeli attacks in Gaza killed at least nine people in the past 48 hours, taking the death toll since the October 2025 “ceasefire” to 1,661, Al Jazeera reported, citing the Palestinian health ministry.
title: Israeli attacks in Gaza kill nine more, pushing death toll to 1,671
